questions: Do you have a fever (measured temperature ≥38°C) or chills?
Do the coughing fits produce any blood or what color is the sputum (if any)?
Are you short of breath or do you have wheezing/stridor when the coughing fits happen?
When you look at the skin lesions/redness, are they raised and itchy hives (wheals), or are they painful/blistering with a non-itchy rash?
Where exactly are the skin lesions/redness located (e.g., face/neck, chest/back, arms/legs, or around the mouth), and do they look like small purple spots/bruises or a widespread rash?
When did the skin redness/swelling start relative to the onset of the coughing fits (which came first, and about how many days apart)?
Do the skin areas have any blistering or open sores, and are you seeing them start as small bumps that then turn into blisters?
Have you checked your temperature at home or in the clinic, and what is your measured temperature (°C/°F)?
Have you started any new medications (especially antibiotics, NSAIDs, or vaccines) or used any new topical products in the past 1–2 weeks?
What is your current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) on room air, and do you have any chest pain when breathing or lying down?
